description: This file defines a class UserManagementEventHooks with static asynchronous methods that handle user-related events such as user creation, sending invitation emails, and creating audit logs in a litellm proxy server context.

classes.name: UserManagementEventHooks
classes.description: A class containing static async methods to handle user management events such as user creation and sending invitation emails, as well as creating audit logs.

methods.name: async_user_created_hook( data: NewUserRequest, response: NewUserResponse, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Handles actions to be performed when a new user is created, including sending an invitation email and creating an audit log.

methods.name: async_send_user_invitation_email( data: NewUserRequest, response: NewUserResponse, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Sends a user invitation email, attempting to use enterprise email hooks if available, otherwise falling back to legacy email logic.

methods.name: send_legacy_v1_user_invitation_email( data: NewUserRequest, response: NewUserResponse, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, event: WebhookEvent, )
methods.description: Sends a legacy-style email invitation to the new user, checking email alerting setup and triggering a Slack alert.

methods.description: Creates an audit log entry for internal user actions, recording details of the change and updating the audit logs if enabled.
